title: Top hat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#5b4a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#7a68b5"/>
  <!-- Hat body -->
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="44" height="58" rx="4" fill="#6b5aa0"/>
  <rect x="28" y="18" width="30" height="58" rx="4" fill="#8574c2"/>
  <!-- Hat top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="18" rx="22" ry="7" fill="#9a8ad4"/>
  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x="28" y="64" width="44" height="8" fill="#3dd6c3"/>
  <rect x="28" y="64" width="30" height="8" fill="#5ee8d8"/>
  <!-- Hat band buckle -->
  <rect x="44" y="63" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <rect x="47" y="65" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill="#6b5aa0"/>
  <!-- Face: eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="40" r="5" fill="#fff8e7"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="40" r="5" fill="#fff8e7"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#2e2050"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#2e2050"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="50" r="4" fill="#ff8fb1"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="50" r="4" fill="#ff8fb1"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 51 Q50 62 60 51" stroke="#fff8e7" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Smile highlight -->
  <path d="M43 53 Q50 60 57 53" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
